title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Completed beverage cooling analysis. Fitted Newton's Law of Cooling to 200-minute temperature time series, identified 2 anomalies (t=80, t=121 min), achieved R²=0.98 on clean data. Generated 4 figures and comprehensive report with methodology, results, and discussion of limitations.
